# InfronixWeb Digital Marketing

> Premier website design, Next.js web development, technical SEO, AI automation, and performance marketing agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

InfronixWeb helps modern businesses design fast web applications, rank #1 on Google, automate workflows with AI and WhatsApp, and scale with high-converting Meta and Google ads.

## Core Services

- [Web Development](https://www.infronixweb.in/web-development): High-performance Next.js web applications, responsive business websites, and custom e-commerce platforms.
- [SEO Optimization](https://www.infronixweb.in/seo): Technical SEO, local search optimization in Ahmedabad & Gujarat, keyword ranking, and Google Search performance.
- [AI Automation](https://www.infronixweb.in/ai-automation): 24/7 AI chatbot assistants, automated WhatsApp messaging, and custom workflow automations.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.infronixweb.in/digital-marketing): Full-funnel digital marketing strategies, performance marketing, and conversion rate optimization.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.infronixweb.in/digital-marketing/social-media-marketing): Organic brand building, content creation, and audience engagement on Instagram and Facebook.
- [Paid Advertising](https://www.infronixweb.in/digital-marketing/paid-advertising): High-ROI paid ad campaigns on Google Search, Meta Ads, and YouTube.
